comments.body:
Based on the mailing list discussion, I've updated the creation responses to fix this bug, and allow returning the RDF of the newly-created resource if requested via a Prefer header:

https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/985
Looks good, pending response to code review comments.

I've updated the PR to address the review comments:

https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/985

Resolved with: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/commit/34b50e13f249a575d2b0fa23788e11d120ebd45e

See follow-on ticket: https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1922

Related PR: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/994

Merged with: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/commit/254213f4a6f4bc441fa288324f10b777cdfd60b4
